note: Declares the private placeholder keys this repo expects, WITHOUT their values. The values live in ~/.ai-tooling/values.json, outside the working tree. Descriptions here must not reveal the value they describe. The build uses this list to recognise a placeholder as legitimate even on a machine (or a CI runner) that has no values file. See docs/security.md.

values.MSK_CLUSTER_NAME: Name of the Kafka/MSK cluster referenced by example queries in the checking-kafka-offset-lag skill.
values.WORK_MARKETPLACE_REPO: Repository name of the employer's internal Claude plugin marketplace, referenced in the settings backup.
values.SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT: Snowflake account identifier passed to the snowflake MCP server in the MCP backup.
values.USER_EMAIL: Work email address used as the Snowflake login in the MCP backup.
